body.statement: Under the continuous Gaussian-copula sampling condition, \(\Pr(\max_{e\in\mathcal E}\lVert\widehat R_e-R_e\rVert_{\max}\le r)\ge1-\alpha\). For every law in \(\mathfrak M_{p,E}(d;\kappa,m,M,b,\delta)\), \(\Pr(G\in\widehat{\mathcal G}_{\alpha})\ge1-\alpha\). If \(r<\kappa/(2p)\), \(b>2K_Br\), and \(\delta>2T\), then on the same simultaneous event \(\widehat{\mathcal G}_{\alpha}=\{G\}\). Here \(b\) is exclusively the minimum signal of \(B^0=B^{\pi_0}(R_0)\), so the threshold, fallback, coverage domain, and singleton conclusion are unchanged by arbitrary positive reference rescaling.
body.justification: The theorem converts rank-only releases into an honest support confidence set with a measurable all-DAG fallback.
body.gap: LiuEtAl2012NPNskeptic, Theorem 4.2, gives the uniform sine-transformed Kendall correlation bound, while Theorem 4.3 transfers it to undirected precision procedures. WangKolarDrton2025ConfidenceOrderings, Theorem 1, gives asymptotic ordering-set validity for residual-bootstrap tests. Neither supplies finite-sample inversion of calibrated multi-environment projective scores or a gauge-invariant directed-support margin.
body.consumer: FedCDH-style sites can send Kendall matrices and sample sizes while the coordinator reports all causal supports not ruled out at level \(\alpha\).
